The '''A-1 Deluxe Floater''', also known simply as the '''A-1 landspeeder''', was a cheap, basic [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]], that featured automated steering and fine [[Corellian leather]]. It was first produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] in the months prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:MobquetA-1Deluxe.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Another view of the A-1 Deluxe Floater]]
The Mobquet A-1 Deluxe floater was a capsule-shaped, yellow-hulled [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] with a pod-like cockpit seating a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and passenger in single file. The speeder's six external [[RS-J24 thruster engine]] modules propelled the A-1 at speeds of around 160 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. A series of inlet ports on the rounded nose drew in air to cool the engines, but the A-1 suffered from insulation problems, noise pollution and the risk of exterior odors filtering into the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].

The 7.1-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long Deluxe floater was affordable at 6,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but lacked any kind of amenities and was considered to be a very basic speeder&mdash;though perfect for [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] or the youthful [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] customization crowd in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].

==History==
More than one of these vehicles could be found in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], including one parked outside [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|the cantina]] while [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] first met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> There was another for sale at [[Spaceport Speeders/Legends|Spaceport Speeders]]<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> when Skywalker sold his [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] there.<ref name="ANH" />

[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valles Santhe]] used this model of landspeeder as her personal transport on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].<ref name="ML">''[[Mission to Lianna]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:A-1_Deluxe_Floater_at_Spaceport_Speeders.jpg|200px|thumb|An A-1 (left) at Spaceport Speeders]]
This vehicle could first be partially seen briefly in the background of Mos Eisley in {{Film|IV}}.<ref name="ANH" /> Full blueprints for the prop, labeled "Mobquet Landspeeder," were published in ''[[Star Wars Blueprints]]'' in [[1977]].<ref name="Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints]]''</ref>

An all-new image of the speeder in Mos Eisley was featured in the [[A New Hope Limited]] set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] in [[1996]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Mobquet A-1 Deluxe Floater}}</ref> A more prominent digital version of the speeder, very similar to the card game version, was added to the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of the film in [[1997]].<ref name="ANH" />

The term "Fine Corellian leather" may be a reference to "Corinthian leather", a marketing term used to describe the upholstery on certain models of Chrysler luxury cars during the 1970s and 1980s.
